texts.en:
Good job. The ship design has been added to our database, and can now be produced by a Starbase that has been equipped with a Shipyard.

The new design can be edited at any time by revisiting the Ship Designer. If any changes are made to the design, then Ships already built will need to be upgraded at a Starbase.

To upgrade a Ship;

£dot_green£ Select the Ship in the Outliner
£dot_green£ Click the Upgrade button in the fleet interface

                        £upgrade_ship£
